vibe_rationale: Surf-club-run, multi-format weekend with a contest, adaptive surf, yoga, workshops, music and a local market; brands woven in, but new and small.
fit_notes: Strong High Ground fit: surf, yoga and mobility in one adult-friendly community weekend running 30 October to 1 November 2026, with partner slots possibly open for 2027. Community depth is unproven in a first edition, and as an Australian brand High Ground would need a local partner.
